comments.body:
`UdpSocket::poll_recv` seems to have this bug as well, `Direction::Read` only maps to `Ready::READABLE | Ready::READ_CLOSED`.

[Rust Playground](https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=stable&mode=release&edition=2024&gist=70a0aece24fb14befd831818502b6e83)

Similarly, when I implemented `poll_recv` for a wrapper type of `AsyncFd<socket2::Socket>`, `AsyncFd::poll_read_ready` is used and testing results indicate the same issue.
@cxw620 I've just added a test with 66a06574, part of https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/pull/8084

> [@cxw620](https://github.com/cxw620) I've just added a test with [66a0657](https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/commit/66a0657405f774306d91727b1898e25f08c8631c), part of [#8084](https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/pull/8084)

https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/actions/runs/25362578266/job/74365642136?pr=8084, maybe we need a timeout when testing so.
